Name: Underground Secrets
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
Underground is an enigmatic place... secrets abound.

This mod aims to make the underground more interesting.


[b][size=5]Features[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]Suspicious shrines
[*]Enchanting altars
[*]Rousing riddles
[*]Tormenting traps
[*]Collapsing caverns
[*]Fungal Flora
[/list]
By default, these secrets are now quite rare close to the surface, but you can modify the [b]config.json[/b] file to change that.

For more detailed information (i.e. spoilers), [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/477]I've created an article with all the information on the mod[/url].

This is a work-in-progress and there may be bugs.

I recommend that you install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7685]Treasure Chests Expanded[/url]﻿ to allow for more modular rewards.

[size=5][b]Other Underground Mods[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5894]Custom Dungeon Floors[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5966]Custom Ore Nodes[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6669]Custom Resource Clumps[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5864]Boss Creatures[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7685]Treasure Chests Expanded[/url]﻿
[/list]

[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
